svg.aria-label: Plate VIII: thirteen-petal gold rosette around an earnings-spire vignette, sow-and-reap microtext ring
svg.title: Plate VIII · The earnings spire
svg.desc: Privately issued banknote plate: a thirteen-petal twin gold lathe rosette; a central vignette of a gold earnings spire curve rising to near-vertical against a falling copper median line over a turnip base band, with figure labels 1 percent, 80/20 and 1890 and a legend reading athletics opera; a circular microtext ring reading WHATSOEVER A MAN SOWETH THAT SHALL HE ALSO REAP, GALATIANS 6:7; denomination cartouches VIII in the four corners.
